---
name: ai-output-review
description: Review AI-generated findings or changes as accepted, amended, rejected, or deferred for SME input.
---
# AI output review

For each output, verify source citations and distinguish facts from inference. Record reviewer, evidence checked, decision, corrections, rejected content and reason, unresolved questions, residual risk, and validation. Accept only the supported portion; defer policy ambiguity to a suitable SME. Passing tests or polished prose is not proof. Use `docs/templates/ai-output-review.md` and the evidence template.
